comparisons.name: entry-light
comparisons.description: The whole face of Calculator, Aqua capture: 42 in the display, the clear key reading C. The crop is the window's frame inset by 2 pt, which leaves the window's rim and corners out. Whole crop: the digits and the function labels are set in the fallback font.

comparisons.name: entry-light-layout
comparisons.description: As entry-light with the text masked (the display's number and the labels of the thirteen keys that show text), to score the grid, its 1 pt gaps, the three fills and the six drawn symbols.

comparisons.name: cleared-dark
comparisons.description: The whole face of Calculator, Dark Aqua capture: cleared, 0 in the display and the clear key reading AC. Same crop as entry-light. Whole crop: the digits and the function labels are set in the fallback font.

comparisons.name: cleared-dark-layout
comparisons.description: As cleared-dark with the same text masked as entry-light-layout, to score the grid, its gaps, the three Dark Aqua fills and the six drawn symbols.

comparisons.name: pressed-digit-light
comparisons.description: The mouse button held on the 7 key, Aqua: the key lightens and its neighbour does not. No screenshot shows a pressed key; the colour is the spec's inferred value.

pixels.note: pressed digit key: white at 40% over #68696b, inferred (spec: calculator-keypad, Colours)
the 8 key beside it keeps the measured digit fill

comparisons.name: pressed-operator-light
comparisons.description: The mouse button held on the multiply key, Aqua: an operator key darkens. Inferred, as no screenshot shows it.

pixels.note: pressed operator key: black at 20% over #ff9f0b, inferred (spec: calculator-keypad, Colours)
the divide key above it keeps the measured operator fill

comparisons.name: pressed-function-dark
comparisons.description: The mouse button held on the percent key, Dark Aqua: a function key lightens. Inferred, as no screenshot shows it.

pixels.note: pressed function key: white at 20% over #424447, inferred (spec: calculator-keypad, Colours)
the clear key in the same row keeps the measured Dark Aqua function fill
